这篇文章是写给第一次在湾区找房、准备换房、找短租或转租的人。重点不是让你怀疑所有: This article is for first-time Bay Area renters, people moving homes, and those seeking short-term rentals or sublets. The point is not to distrust every listing, but to avoid common problems before viewings, transfers, and lease signing, and screen out clearly risky situations early.
先判断这是不是一个正常租房流程: First, check whether this looks like a normal rental process
正常流程通常是先看房或视频看房，再确认出租人身份、房屋地址、费用结构、入住时间和: A typical process starts with an in-person or live video viewing, followed by confirming the landlord's identity, property address, costs, move-in date, and lease terms before discussing payment. Be cautious if someone immediately pushes you to send money, threatens to give the home to someone else unless you pay, or keeps refusing to show you the property.
看房前先核对的几件事: What to check before a viewing
把地址放到地图里看一遍，确认确实有这个房子，不是空地、办公楼或明显不匹配的地点。: Look up the address on a map and confirm that a home exists there, rather than a vacant lot, office building, or obviously mismatched location.
看图片和租金是否合理，如果同区域明显便宜很多，要先问原因，不要只觉得捡到便宜。: Check whether the photos and rent make sense. If it's far cheaper than nearby listings, ask why instead of assuming you've found a bargain.
要求对方说明自己是房东、物业、主租人还是室友，身份说法前后不一致就先别继续。: Ask whether the person is the landlord, property manager, primary tenant, or a roommate. Pause if their account of their role is inconsistent.
不能线下看房时，尽量要求实时视频看房，不要只看预录视频或几张截图。: If you can't visit in person, request a live video viewing rather than relying on prerecorded videos or screenshots.
先问清楚月租、押金、租期、是否包水电网、有没有停车位、能不能养宠物。: Ask about monthly rent, deposit, term, included utilities and internet, parking, and pet rules.
转账前最容易出事的地方: Common trouble spots before transferring money
湾区很多租房纠纷不是出在合同太复杂，而是出在钱转得太早。没看房、没确认身份、没看: Many Bay Area rental disputes start with paying too early, not with an overly complex contract. Before viewing, verifying identity, and receiving clear written terms, avoid sending Zelle, Cash App, Venmo, or other payments that may be hard to recover. Pause especially if the other person wants an immediate payment to a personal account.
先确认这笔钱到底是什么：申请费、holding deposit、押金，还是第一月: Confirm exactly what the payment is for: an application fee, holding deposit, security deposit, or first month's rent.
先确认收款人姓名和出租人身份是否一致。: Confirm that the recipient's name matches the person renting out the property.
先确认如果没租成，这笔钱是否可退，怎么退，最好有书面说明。: First confirm whether the payment is refundable if you don't rent the place, and how it would be refunded. Get this in writing if possible.
不要因为对方说自己人在外州、国外、出差、钥匙托管，就跳过核验。: Don't skip verification because the other person says they're out of state, abroad, on a business trip, or using a key-holding service.
签合同前一定要问清楚什么: What to clarify before signing a lease
很多人抢房时只看月租和入住日期，结果后面才发现停车、清洁、续租、提前搬走、加室友: When competing for housing, people often focus only on monthly rent and move-in date, then discover restrictions on parking, cleaning, renewal, early departure, or adding roommates. Before signing, at least clarify costs, lease length, repair responsibilities, subletting restrictions, and move-out requirements. For deposits, application fees, and early termination liability, refer to the contract and official information.
一个简单判断方法: A simple way to assess the situation
如果你发现自己已经开始因为怕错过房子，而忽略了地址核验、身份核验和书面说明，这通: If fear of missing out makes you skip verifying the address, identity, and written details, it's usually time to slow down. A reliable housing provider generally doesn't mind a few extra questions.
这些信号值得直接放弃: Warning signs worth walking away from
对方拒绝实时看房，只愿意发照片。: They refuse a live viewing and only offer photos.
一上来就要求先付全额押金或大额订金。: They immediately demand the full security deposit or a large advance payment.
价格特别低，但解释一直含糊。: The price is unusually low, but the explanation stays vague.
合同或付款说明迟迟不给，只让你先转钱。: They keep delaying the lease or payment terms and tell you to transfer money first.
说房子很多人抢，但连基本信息都讲不清楚。: They say many people want the home but can't explain basic details.
